title: Kamfen, sassan abokin ciniki da amintaccen aiki da kai tare da AI

say: Kamfen, sassan abokin ciniki da amintaccen aiki da kai tare da AI.
Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar biyu na AI don Talla da Automation.

Kuskuren gama gari shine tambayar AI don kowane yanki daban. Sannan WhatsApp yayi alkawarin abu daya da Instagram wani. Don haka da farko, rubuta ainihin takardar saƙon da kanka: manufa, tayin, masu sauraro, hujja ta gaske da kuma kira ɗaya zuwa mataki.

card.title: Albarka ta gwada rubutun talla guda uku

say: Tana amfani da zaɓin gwajin A/B a cikin Meta Ads Manager, don haka kowane rubutu yana samun daidaitaccen naira 5,000. Hoton da masu sauraro sun kasance iri ɗaya. Rubutun kawai yana canzawa.

card.title: Albarka ta gwada rubutun talla guda uku

say: Bayan kwanaki 5, rubutun da farashin ke jagoranta ya kai kusan naira 42 a dannawa ɗaya. Rubutun da ke haifar da damuwa, babu fargabar biredi na ƙarshe, farashin naira 25. Rubutun da ke jagorantar hujja ya kai kusan 63.

say: Yin aiki da kai yana nufin faɗakarwa, aiki da bincike na yau da kullun daga gare ku. Saita gaisuwar Kasuwancin ku ta WhatsApp, saƙon nesa da amsa cikin sauri.

Amma saƙon kawai mutanen da suka yarda, da kuma sauƙaƙe tsayawa. Masu zamba suna kwafi sunayen kasuwanci suna aika lambobin asusun karya, don haka rubuta bayanan asusun ku na hukuma da kanku kuma kada ku bari AI ta canza su.
Kuma gunaguni, maidowa da umarni na al'ada koyaushe suna samun amsa na sirri.
